{"metadata":{"description":"Meta-Problem Modeling (MPM) cognitive flywheel as a resident engine for LLM agent runtimes. 六阶段问题生命周期 · ε-δ 双判据收敛 · 代谢账本 · 导师规则层","id":"gh:1351102240","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"metaflywheel","slug":"NBagent-dev/metaflywheel","topics":["agent-tools","cognitive-architecture","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm-agents","meta-reasoning"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Meta-Problem Modeling (MPM) cognitive flywheel as a resident engine for LLM agent runtimes. 六阶段问题生命周"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"期 · ε-δ 双判据收敛 · 代谢账本 · 导师规则层"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# metaflywheel"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A cross-session ledger for an AI assistant. It stores the corrections a user made, the mistakes the "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"assistant actually made, and the conditions under which a task counts as finished, and it returns th"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e relevant record at the moment it is needed."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**The long-term aim is to create consciousness. The road is very long**, so this repository works on"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ly on the part that can be attempted without self-deception: a continuous record maintained by the s"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ubject itself, allowed to overrule its own code."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The repository is written by its own subject. The ledger records each decision during execution, and"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" those records are then used to amend the engine."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## A concrete example"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A user corrects the assistant once: *read a file before editing it*."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Three weeks later the assistant attempts to edit a file it has not read. The attempt is refused, and"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" in the same tool return, next to the refusal, the ledger supplies the original correction with the "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ID it was filed under, together with the two earlier occasions of the same mistake."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The scope is deliberately narrow. The objective is not to make the assistant remember more; it is to"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" make a stored correction arrive at the moment it applies. A record that only surfaces when someone "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"remembers to look it up cannot prevent the mistake it describes."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Scope and non-goals"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| The repository does | The repository does not |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| store corrections, mistakes, open debts and explicit boundaries | claim or measure consciousness |"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"
| return them on concrete events (a failing tool, a missing path, a malformed ID) | change model we"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ights, train, or fine-tune |
| expose every decision in a ledger that can be read and audited | repl"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ace general-purpose memory or retrieval systems |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"A memory store answers whether something can be kept. This project addresses whether it arrives at t"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"he right moment, which is a different problem and needs a different instrument. If the requirement i"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"s simply that the assistant remembers more, a vector store is sufficient and this project is not nee"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"mply that the assistant remembers more, a vector store is sufficient and this project is not needed."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The engine includes a self-assessment panel for a set of measurable indicators; the panel itself sta"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"tes that an all-green result means only that the auditable part is auditable."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Getting started"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The test suite has no network, database or service dependency and runs on a clean clone."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"This is a plugin, not a standalone application: it requires a host to run in. Mounting and deploymen"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"t are described in docs/install.md."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The ledger attaches to a single line of a DSH composition config as a `file://` URL. No separate pro"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"cess is started. Four record types are maintained between the assistant and its user:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Record | Content |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Debt | work that was declared and has not been completed |
| Criterion | the checkable condition u"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"nder which the work counts as finished |
| Lesson | a mistake that occurred, described by its shape "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"rather than its moral |
| Boundary | what has been explicitly written down as out of scope |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Retrieval is event-triggered rather than self-triggered. The assistant does not decide to consult it"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s memory; a failing tool, a missing path or a malformed ID causes the relevant record to be included"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" in the same tool return."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## The loop and its gates"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The problem lifecycle is `G` generate → `F` frame → `S` solve → `C` converge → `D` deposit → `E` evo"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" problem lifecycle is `G` generate → `F` frame → `S` solve → `C` converge → `D` deposit → `E` evoke."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Each stage has a gate that can refuse the transition:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Stage | Gate | Refuses |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| F | `delta`: framing precision, 0–1, lower is better | a statement missing initial state, goal, co"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"nstraints, available operators or success criterion |
| C | `epsilon` (distance to goal) **and** `de"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"lta` | convergence while either value is too large; convergence immediately after a re-frame is reje"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"cted outright |
| D | `links`, or an explicit `linkReason` | a deposit that claims no ancestry and g"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ives no reason |
| E | friction against an existing deposit | a new problem with no origin |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"A ledger whose only reachable output is "success" cannot be audited. Every gate above exists so that"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" a failed step has a defined place to be stopped, including the engine's own."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## What can be verified"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Three checking layers are in place, each able to detect what the previous layer cannot."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Layer | Checker | Trigger |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Documentation agrees with the filesystem | `test/audit-consistency.mjs` | every `node --test` |
| "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"The filesystem agrees with the repository | `tools/pre-commit` | every `git commit` |
| The reposito"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"ry agrees with a fresh checkout | CI runs `node --test` on a clean clone | every push |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The claim specific to this repository is also checkable without trusting the author. Every commit me"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"ssage carries an ID; each ID is a deposit; each deposit is a file written by the engine at runtime, "},{"id":"p35s3","text":"containing a timestamp, the problem it solved and any correction it received later. Any ID from any "},{"id":"p35s4","text":"commit can be followed to its deposit through docs/ledger.md."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Current position"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The roadmap separates the objective into four faults. The order is fixed: continuous observation fir"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"st, measurement second."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"| Fault | Description | State |"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| ① Measurement | `delta`, `epsilon`, `S`, `A_k` without objective proxies | partial: `delta` and `e"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"psilon` are self-reported; the proxy count changes and is read from the engine snapshot rather than "},{"id":"p39s3","text":"restated here |
| ② Continuity | from running-on-call to running-continuously | crossed: patrol runs"},{"id":"p39s4","text":", with rhythm, throttle and quiet hours implemented |
| ③ Autonomy | given continuity, originating p"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"roblems without a request | not crossed: patrol does not originate problems, and the level of wantin"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"g does not exist |
| ④ Multi-subject | long term | not started |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Open gaps"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"Each item is read out of the ledger rather than listed as a wish."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"| Gap | State |"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
